applies_why: The judge text breaks a challenger link using verses (Matthew 1:18, 25; Luke 1:34), which the rule governs.
quote: [L1] Matthew 1:18 "before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost" and Matthew 1:25 "knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son" contradict C3's claim of espousal union
rule_words: A verse counts against a link only if an earlier round pressed it against that link. The judge must quote that round's sentence and name the round.
room: 'must quote that round's sentence and name the round' -- either the judge must name the pressing round and quote its sentence when using a verse against a link, or this applies only to verses it separately cites; the judge text names no round and quotes no earlier sentence.
why: The judge uses Matthew 1:18 and 1:34 to break a link without naming any round that pressed them or quoting that round's sentence.
